mods.name: Alloy Area Scanner
mods.changelog: New Alloy look: the scanner screen now matches Alloy Hub (Settings, Custom blocks and Presets tabs, block suggestions as you type, confirm before deleting a preset). Own Alloy Hub page with a Custom blocks tab. HUD follows the Alloy theme. Your settings, hotkeys, custom list and presets carry over.

mods.name: Alloy Backups
mods.changelog: Preview button in the area restore screen: see the selected chunks of a backup as a Litematica schematic before restoring.

mods.name: Alloy Bot Macros
mods.changelog:
Live progress: each macro in the menu shows the step it is on and what it waits for.
Failed steps (a refused command, a bot that didn't join, a wait that gave up) show their reason on the macro and as a toast.
The menu no longer pauses singleplayer, so macros keep running while it's open.
If the server hasn't answered yet, the menu says so and has a Retry button. Update the server too.

mods.name: Alloy Carpet
mods.changelog:
Trash list in /cytra menu: Digging and Nether presets add a whole set of stone-type items in one click
Add from your inventory: click an item icon to put it on your trash list

mods.name: Alloy Container
mods.changelog: - Live storage counts: the server now sends a linked container's contents as soon as it changes, instead of your client re-reading every linked container every few seconds. Much less server load with big groups. Needs 1.6.0 on the server too; older servers keep working the old way.

mods.name: Alloy Creative
mods.changelog: /weather in a lab now changes that lab's weather (rain and thunder work in labs)

mods.name: Alloy FX
mods.changelog:
Lighter on busy servers
- Armor is themed when equipment changes (and when entities load, players join, theme picks or settings change) instead of checking every entity every second; same results, far less server work
- A slow safety sweep every 5 minutes remains (armorSweepSeconds, replaces armorInterval)
- Tested with a real server, two Alloy Pack Mixer players and one vanilla player: all checks pass

mods.name: Alloy Hub
mods.changelog:
- Changelogs for Alloy Map 0.28.0 and Alloy Ledger 0.7.0
- HUD Layout: the Alloy Syncmatica material HUD box uses the HUD's real size (with the next Syncmatica)

mods.name: Alloy Ledger
mods.changelog:
Item frames, glow item frames, paintings and armor stands are logged (placed, broken, items put in or taken out) and /ll rollback puts them back; ones changed since are left alone
/ll search with filters: a:break,place b:diamond_ore,!dirt p:Steve r:20 t:2d
/ll rollback search rolls back only what matches (needs t: and p: or r:)
Faster lookups: hours that can't match are skipped

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- World map layer picker (scaffolding button, or [ and ]): look at any Nether or cave layer you've mapped, or the surface / Nether roof
- Smoother minimap when travelling fast (elytra, boats, minecarts)
- For mod makers: other mods can show temporary markers on the maps (AlloyMapApi)

mods.name: Alloy Map
mods.changelog:
- World map layer picker (scaffolding button, or [ and ]): look at any Nether or cave layer you've mapped, or the surface / Nether roof
- Smoother minimap when travelling fast (elytra, boats, minecarts)
- For mod makers: other mods can show temporary markers on the maps (AlloyMapApi)

mods.name: Alloy Mass Craft
mods.changelog:
Fixed: crafting Bone Block (or anything whose ingredient can be made back from it) counted the blocks you already had, so Can craft was far too high and the craft stopped with ingredients missing
When an ingredient runs out, the message now says which one and how many were found

mods.name: Alloy Pack Mixer
mods.changelog: Works hand in hand with Alloy FX 0.9.0: the server says which themes it handles, so themed sounds and armour come from one place, never twice and never silent. Swords, axes and spears get themed hit sounds; every theme has its own sounds (Alloy Pack 1.5.2). THEMES preview always shows your pick. Faster item drawing and tidier internals; your settings carry over.

mods.name: Alloy Printer
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: Printer, Accuracy, Blocks and Extras tabs
Alloy Hub page: printing switch, status, settings, quick actions and the status box position
Ops can turn the server placement helper on or off from the Hub's Server tab
Block lists are typed as one line, like stone, #minecraft:logs
Printer messages are translatable

mods.name: Alloy Send
mods.changelog: Cytra Send is now Alloy Send. Renamed from Cytra to Alloy, with the new Alloy logo. Nothing else changes: settings, commands and saved data stay the same.

mods.name: Alloy Shulker View
mods.changelog:
- Hovering a shulker now shows all 27 slots as a grid, tinted to the box's colour, instead of the text list (counts, durability bars and enchant glint included)
- New settings: preview on/off, only while holding Shift, and compact (same items merged with their total)
- Turns itself off when ShulkerBoxTooltip is installed

mods.name: Alloy Sticky Toggle
mods.changelog:
Settings screen in the Alloy look (works without MaLiLib)
Alloy Hub page with every block and setting
Renamed to Alloy Sticky Toggle

mods.name: Alloy Syncmatica
mods.changelog:
- Material list, shopping list, layers and projects screens in the Alloy look: dropdowns, search, toggles, confirm dialogs and toasts
- Material HUD drawn in your Alloy theme
- /cytra-syncmatica where finds the real centre of rotated and mirrored builds

mods.name: Alloy Trades
mods.changelog:
New settings screen in the Alloy look: tool row, favourites you can reorder or remove (with a confirm), toasts
All text is now translatable
Hint when a stick is set as the trade tool while Litematica is loaded

mods.name: Alloy Waypoints
mods.changelog:
New Alloy look for the waypoint menu, routes and forms (follows your Hub theme)
Settings screen (gear in the menu, or Mod Menu): on/off, Xaero sync, Esc-menu button, default sort, remember last view, menu key
Add to Xaero, Edit, Set status, Teleport and Remove are in the ⋯ menu; Remove asks first
Server answers show as pop-ups

mods.name: Cytra Link
mods.changelog: Built with the same tools as the other Alloy mods; nothing changes on the server.

mods.name: Return Cannon Maker
mods.changelog: - Built with the same tools as the other Alloy mods (Java 21); nothing changes in game
